title: CISA Catalog of Known Exploited Vulnerabilities

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: XZ Utils Embedded Malicious Code Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: A malicious backdoor was inserted into liblzma in XZ Utils 5.6.0 and 5.6.1.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or downgrade to a known-good version.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Apache Log4j2 Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Apache Log4j2 contains a JNDI lookup vulnerability that allows remote code execution.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Upgrade to Log4j 2.17.0 or apply mitigations.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: PAN-OS contains a command injection vulnerability in the GlobalProtect feature.
